note: Machine-readable inventory of everything this fork adds on top of upstream. Drives `bun run fork:verify` (run after every sync to prove nothing was silently dropped) and `bun run sync:check` (detect when upstream has moved past our baseline). Update `baseline` after each successful sync. Keep the human-readable rationale in FORK_WORKFLOW.md in step with this file.

baseline.comment: Last upstream commit fully merged into dev. sync:check compares upstream/dev against this ref. Bump it (and forkTag) after every sync. As of 2026-08-12, sync:check reports upstream 22 commits ahead — a sync is due but deliberately deferred until in-flight gallery/skein-migration planning lands.

_ownedRemoved_2026-08-12.note: auto-reply.ts, automation-features.ts, pattern-detection.ts (+ its two CLI commands), scheduler.ts, and hook.ts were deliberately deleted 2026-08-07 (commits 88731dfc6f, 0530944759) for being dead/broken code, not lost in a merge. fork:verify was reporting all 7 as regressions because this manifest was never updated at deletion time. Removed here, not re-added.

patched.note: Registers all fork CLI commands via a single .command(ForkCommands). The upstream command block must stay byte-identical to upstream.
In-app updater points at the fork (releaseRepo/installUrl/npm/brew), never upstream, so an update prompt cannot clobber our binary.
Multi-select discovered local providers; graceful mDNS failure.
Unified context bar, % inline, breakdown below; Context label; cost for cloud providers.

createEffect writing ThemeState.set(store.active) — the writer half of the local-backend themed-loading-screen feature (reader is provider.ts ThemeState.get). theme-state.ts now lives in packages/core/src/local so both the TUI (writer) and the opencode provider (reader) can share the singleton across the package boundary. Confirmed present 2026-08-12 — this was flagged REGRESSED in FORK_WORKFLOW.md since 2026-06-18 but had already been re-applied; that stale note is removed.
Names the binary location in the self-upgrade 400 error so a dev build's bare 'Update failed' becomes actionable.

Two patches, only the first is machine-checked: (1) diagnosticsFor's legacy/modern era detection from getDiscoverResult() plus tolerating a capability-discovery read failure without throwing a defect (marker above); (2) the v2 logging-level switch's default case (SEP-2577) — return logInfo, never silently drop a server log line for a level value outside the 8-value RFC 5424 enum the switch enumerates.

@modelcontextprotocol/core re-exports the Zod schema values needed for .extend()/.omit(); the plain inferred type lives on @modelcontextprotocol/client instead — bridges list-tools parsing across that package split from v1's single sdk/types.js export.

patched.marker: opencode server worker crashed during startup
patched.note: Surfaces a dead server worker's real error (module-eval crash, OOM kill) instead of leaving the TUI on a black screen with every pending RPC call unresolved.

Three patches, only the first is machine-checked: (1) hop a subagent inheriting a local provider to an idle local peer instead of queueing behind its parent on the same often-single-slot llama.cpp server, honoring an explicit host request loudly rather than silently placing elsewhere (marker above); (2) SUBAGENT_TASK_TIMEOUT_MS backstop, deliberately above provider.ts's header-timeout default; (3) 'Foreground is the default' prompt wording fix — the original wording reliably produced all-foreground fan-out.

Leading-indicator overflow check: estimates the outgoing prompt (not just the last completed turn's reported usage) so a single large tool result or file read triggers pre-emptive compaction before it causes a mid-session 413 on local backends.

Three patches, only the first is machine-checked: (1) bigram-similarity (>=0.92) loop detection breaking after 3 consecutive near-identical no-tool-call turns (marker above, LoopMaxStreak); (2) DefaultSubAgentSteps step cap for parentID sessions, overridable by the agent's own steps setting; (3) single forced-tool-choice retry state at the loop-exit empty-turn check.

Throttles summarize()'s full-diff persist to once per MinFullRunIntervalMs per session, plus a single-in-flight cap. processor.ts calls summarize() every step of every turn and event-sourced storage never overwrites, so unthrottled this grew one real session to 12,881 message.updated rows / 1.6 GB (observed 2026-07-26).
Marks a tool (registry and MCP) as active so the stream watchdog doesn't count our own tool's runtime as provider silence. Pairs with the new owned file session/tool-activity.ts.
Surfaces the self-upgrade endpoint's actual error (dev build, script exit code, network) instead of a bare 'Update failed'.

Three patches, only the first is machine-checked: (1) explains why the background-subagents keybind silently no-ops when OPENCODE_EXPERIMENTAL_BACKGROUND_SUBAGENTS is unset, instead of discarding the response (marker above); (2) AssistantMessage prefixes the provider id onto the model name so 'which machine ran this' is answerable when local models share an ID across hosts (see provider?.options?.["baseURL"]); (3) markdown code blocks draw unstyled text immediately instead of blocking render on tree-sitter highlighting.
